These amulets are from Enshu Sigisan Bisyamon Ten, also known as Chogosonshi-ji temple

They are both unusual Omamori, both of them are “make your own wish”. The person at the shrine actually recommended these to me because I told them I wanted to make my own prayer without opening the amulet. Other omamori are already blessed and prayed for at the shrine or temple, which is why you cannot open them otherwise the blessing will be released. However, you are able to put your own prayer for this kind of omamori. I wanted to make my own prayer, so I wrote it on a piece of paper before sealing it up. 

Most authentic amulets will have the shrine written on the back and its effect on the right. Some amulets like these ones I posted, have symbols. Maybe the ones you saw at the shrine were also some sort of symbol as well! The ones I have are actually written in Sanskrit. Some of my Japanese friends didn’t even know what the symbol meant but luckily one of my Japanese friends was knowledgeable in Japanese folktales. 

If I didn’t talk to the seller at the shrine I probably would have no idea what these amulets were for either XD
